briefTitle: Testing the Impact of an Anti-Cancer Drug, Atezolizumab, After Surgery to Prevent Early Stage Non-small Cell Lung Cancer From Returning, AASI-NSCLC Trial

typedChecks.sourceText: Age ≥ 18 years
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status ≤ 2 (or Karnofsky ≥ 60%)
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status ≤ 2 (or Karnofsky ≥ 60%)

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patient must have undergone complete surgical resection with negative margins (complete R0 resection). Surgical resection must be lobectomy or higher, unless the tumor measured no more than 2 cm based on clinical staging, where sub-lobar resection, e.g., wedge or segmentectomy, will be acceptable
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Surgical resection type and margin status require specific procedural and imaging evaluation beyond a simple typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patient must have undergone adequate nodal sampling as defined by Commission on Cancer, 2020 Standard.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Nodal sampling adequacy is a procedural surgical requirement, not a typed biomarker or lab check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Recovered from surgical resection as determined by the treating provider or the investigator
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Recovery from surgery is investigator-dependent and subjective.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Tumors with any histology are allowed including both squamous and non-squamous subtypes, except those containing small-cell morphology. Non-squamous histology includes adenocarcinoma, large cell neuroendocrine, poorly differentiated tumors and adenosquamous, etc
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Histology includes complex subtypes and exceptions (large cell neuroendocrine, poorly differentiated, etc.) that do not map directly to the standardized single-value histology enums.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patient must have undergone complete surgical resection with negative margins (complete R0 resection). Surgical resection must be lobectomy or higher, unless the tumor measured no more than 2 cm based on clinical staging, where sub-lobar resection, e.g., wedge or segmentectomy, will be acceptable
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Surgical resection criteria and sub-lobar options are complex procedural rules, not simple typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patient must have undergone adequate nodal sampling as defined by Commission on Cancer, 2020 Standard. Adequate nodal sampling includes pathological evaluation of at least one (named and/or numbered) hilar station (level 10 or higher) and at least three distinct (named and or numbered) mediastinal stations (level 2-9)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Surgical nodal sampling requirements are procedural rules, not simple typed biomarker or lab checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patient to be registered to A082302 no earlier than 21 days and no later than 77 days from surgical resection
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Post-surgical registration timing window is a protocol-specific logistical timeline, not a typed clinical check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: No prior neoadjuvant or adjuvant therapy for current lung cancer diagnosis
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior therapy exclusion specifies neoadjuvant or adjuvant treatment for the current diagnosis rather than a simple categorical prior therapy rule.
